name: Vicissitude — 3 Advanced — Breath of the Dragon

system.description: Spend a Blood Trait and defeat a single target within 100 feet in a Physical Challenge to inflict three levels of aggravated damage and set him ablaze, dealing two more levels next turn and one each subsequent turn until extinguished or he dies. Alternatively, spend five Blood Traits to incinerate a 20-foot-radius area within 100 feet, dealing two aggravated levels to everyone inside and igniting flammable objects; victims must win a Static Physical Challenge (difficulty five) to avoid catching fire themselves. You are immune to this flame but not to secondary fires it starts.
system.bloodCost: 1 Blood Trait (single target) or 5 Blood Traits (area)
